dedupe_keys.name: experimental and numerical modeling database of reinforced concrete walls

description: Experimental and numerical modeling database of reinforced concrete walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "hybrid simulation", published or maintained by Yiqiu Lu, Tongji University (tongji.edu.cn). This database includes a reinforced concrete experimental database and a numerical modeling database. The experimental database has 276 reinforced concrete wall test data, from 49 test projects, detailed parameters about basic data of database walls, reinforced concrete wall reinforcement data, reinforced concrete wall experimental data and database attachments were introduced in the instruction. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "hybrid simulation" project. Keywords: Wall, concrete, experimental test, numerical modelling. Published 2024-06-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
